constant_status_values.CURRENT: Value in use; source located and quoted.
constant_status_values.PENDING_RULING: Value computed from its source; its adoption waits for a ruling by Pete.
constant_status_values.RETIRED_AS_ANCHOR: Kept only for comparison with older products. Do not use it as the F-35A point under the module definition.
constant_status_values.AGENT_CHOICE_NOT_RULED: Chosen by an agent, not ruled by Pete. Open proposal; state it as an assumption.
constant_status_values.CONVENTION_NO_LOCATED_SOURCE: Module convention in code; no published source located.
constant_status_values.EXTERNAL_STANDARD: Value from an external standard (cited in the note); the standard document is not in the repo.
constant_status_values.EVIDENCE: Measured or derived value that enters only through its measurement model (a point on a curve, a consistency check); not a parameter and not awaiting a ruling. Use it with the propagation chain of its definition class.
constant_status_values.SUPERSEDED: Replaced; kept for provenance. The note names the replacement.
